result.title: Shared Context, Separate Engines: Streaming Vision--Language Inference on Edge SoCs
result.summary: Edge SoCs pack CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, yet vision--language model (VLM) runtimes keep generation on one engine and leave the others idle. Streaming VLMs expose further parallelism: new frames arrive while earlier queries are still being answered. Engines differ in compute and memory access and contend when they co-run, so no single placement of stages wins across SoCs and workloads. Backend-local KV state keeps other engines from continuing the work. \name coordinates heterogeneous accelerators to execute stateful VLM inference concurrently. It separates a stream's versioned context from each engine's KV state, so any engine can continue the stream by reusing, importing, or reconstructing that state. Stateful Streaming Generation ingests new frames on one engine while another answers, and Concurrent Sequence Generation serves different ready requests in parallel. State-aware dispatch sends each request to the engine expected to finish it first. Each answer reads a fixed, published version of its history and matches its serial reference. \name beats the strongest single-engine baselines on Apple M4 Max, Rockchip RK3588, and Qualcomm QCS6490, even when they reuse context. On two RK3588 video streams, it delivers $19.6\%$ more throughput than the best single engine with context reuse and $27.2\%$ more than parallel engines without shared state. Cross-engine KV import cuts first-token latency by a factor of $4.6$ over prefix recomputation. Stateful Streaming Generation delivers up to $2.48\times$ the throughput of serial execution, and state-aware dispatch cuts query completion time by up to $72.7\%$.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个面向边缘 SoC 的运行时系统，把流式 VLM 的版本化上下文与各引擎私有的 KV 状态解耦，使 CPU/GPU/NPU 能并发执行有状态推理，并按预计完成时间调度请求。
AI.relevance_reason: 跨引擎 KV 导入、按固定版本复用或重建状态，以及导入与前缀重算的成本对照，可能为 LVR 中视觉上下文缓存、状态迁移与重算代价核算提供线索；但该文只做系统吞吐/延迟优化，未触及 latent 状态内容，需核查其状态版本语义是否可迁移。
